title: Explainability of genotype embedding models through observed cohort paths
abstract: arXiv:2611.25681v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep learning models that combine genotypes with neuroimaging predict neurological diseases more accurately than either modality alone. Their clinical use, however, requires identifying which genetic variants a prediction is based on. Path-based attribution methods like Integrated Gradients address this by integrating the model's gradient from a baseline to the input. These methods assume the model accepts any point along that path as a valid input. Genotype models violate this assumption. They map the three discrete allele dosages \{0,1,2\} to vectors through a learned embedding defined only at those values, so a straight line passes through fractional genotypes at which no embedding, and therefore no gradient, exists. Attribution must therefore proceed in embedding space where the choice of path can affect the resulting attribution. We show that the commonly used per-variant estimator does not generally satisfy completeness. Additive s

translated_title: 基于观察队列路径的基因型嵌入模型可解释性研究
translated_abstract: 将基因型与神经影像相结合的深度学习模型在预测神经系统疾病方面比单独使用任何一种模态都更为准确。然而，要将其用于临床，需要确定预测所依据的是哪些基因变异。诸如积分梯度等基于路径的归因方法通过从基线到输入对模型梯度进行积分来解决这一问题。这些方法假设模型能够接受该路径上的任意点作为有效输入，而基因型模型违反了这一假设。基因型模型通过仅在三个离散等位基因剂量{0,1,2}处定义的学习嵌入将这些剂量映射为向量，因此直线路径会经过分数基因型，而在这些点上既不存在嵌入，也不存在梯度。因此，归因必须在嵌入空间中进行，而路径的选择可能会影响最终的归因结果。我们证明，常用的逐变异估计量通常不满足完备性。
tldr: 该研究揭示了积分梯度等路径归因方法无法直接用于基因型嵌入模型的原因——离散等位基因剂量的学习嵌入在分数基因型处无定义、无梯度——并提出在嵌入空间中沿观察到的队列路径进行归因，同时证明常用的逐变异估计量不满足完备性。
en_tdlr: This paper explains why path-based attribution methods like Integrated Gradients fail for genotype embedding models, whose learned embeddings are defined only at discrete allele dosages {0,1,2} and thus lack gradients at fractional genotypes, and proposes performing attribution along observed cohort paths in embedding space, while showing that the commonly used per-variant estimator does not satisfy completeness.
